items.text: The canonical main navigation label is VBot and bots.html is the direct one-level storefront
items.acceptance: customer navigation routes VBot to bots.html without an intermediate category page

items.text: The VBot storefront shows public app listing and inline detail from active Vision 7 app facts
items.acceptance: listing and validated code detail return app name description cover platform version and key offers without object storage keys or a public installer URL

items.text: Public store and cart expose only positive active customer offers for monthly yearly or lifetime keys
items.acceptance: test trial admin unknown null zero negative inactive draft or mismatched offers are hidden by the API and cannot be added or ordered

items.text: Installer download and the customer key unlock together only after approved purchase
items.acceptance: the download endpoint requires the owning account and a matching active or trial nonexpired license; pre-purchase access is denied

items.text: Each paid key offer uses a real product row categorized vbot-key with product kind vision7-key
items.acceptance: product price equals authoritative offer price in satang and hidden offers remain draft

items.text: Checkout creates the paid key entitlement and installer entitlement together only after paid approval
items.acceptance: the server revalidates plan and price, excludes key offers from discounts, and idempotent fulfillment issues one owned key per order item

items.text: One key binds one shop only for V Easy even when all VBot applications share the storefront
items.acceptance: shop binding remains platform_type veasy scoped and generic VBot offers do not inherit the shop rule
